recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a man in a fedora and dark sweater, bisected by a sharp diagonal black geometric shape containing a thin vertical red line, set against a cream background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark clothing merging into the black geometric background element
Sharp diagonal division between cream negative space and black graphic block
Thin red vertical line acting as a vibrant counterpoint to the monochromatic palette
Text blocks anchored to the horizontal axes of the subject's head and torso
coreInvariants: Cream, black, and red color palette
Italicized sans-serif typography in rectangular boxes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly left of center, medium shot from waist up, arms crossed.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the brim of the fedora serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the face to the top-right text block, down the diagonal black edge to the bottom-left text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large cream-colored triangular area in the upper left provides breathing room.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black against Cream for high-impact legibility
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red for the text background and vertical accent line
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast; the red is the only saturated element.

composition.position: Top right, within a red rectangle
Middle left, within a black rectangle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and color inversions.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern grotesque feel.
Provides the necessary geometric rigidity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black fedora and dark textured sweater against a cream background. Apply a sharp diagonal black mask from the top right corner to the bottom center. Add a thin vertical red line on the far right side of the black area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two rectangular boxes: one red box in the top right with black italicized sans-serif text, and one black box in the middle left with white italicized sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the diagonal split sharp and clean?
Are the text boxes perfectly horizontal?
Is the red accent line thin and perfectly vertical?
Is the subject's clothing merging into the black background area?

adjustableVariables: Width of the text bounding boxes
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Original artist name and album title text

mustAchieve: High contrast between cream and black
Clean, professional studio lighting on the face
avoid: Soft or blurry edges on graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible within the boxes.
Check that the diagonal line does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the red color is consistent between the box and the line.
Confirm the italic slant is uniform across all text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast studio portrait with a 45-degree geometric split, using a three-color palette (Cream, Black, Red) and boxed italicized sans-serif typography for a 1980s graphic design look.
